title: Two Plans (Pro Annual And API)
style: synth wave, retro 80s arpeggios, gated drums, male sincere lead vocal, female harmony chorus, neon-pads, 118 BPM, account-scan-anthem, two-plans-builder, dual-lane
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Let me look into that for you
Thank you for reaching out about a refund
I'm going to look up your account
Information now — hold the line don't run

I can see you have two plans
On the system that I scan
One is Pro Annual on the org
One is API on the plan

[Pre-Chorus]
Which plan are you requesting
The refund for today
What is the reason for your request
Select from the menu say

[Chorus]
TWO PLANS — TWO PLANS
PRO ANNUAL AND THE API
TWO PLANS — TWO PLANS
ONE FOR THE BUILD ONE FOR THE WHY
TWO PLANS — TWO PLANS
ONE FOR THE CHAT ONE FOR THE CODE
TWO PLANS — TWO PLANS
BOTH OF THEM CARRY THE LOAD

[Verse 2]
Service outage — technical issues
Unwanted auto renewal
Accidental purchase — another reason
Pick the dropdown that's available

I'll route your case to the right queue
I'll tag your ticket with the code
I'll mark you as a priority
I'll send you down the road

[Bridge — spoken]
The API plan is named zynthio.
The Pro plan is on the personal email.
The builder runs both at once.
The builder picks both lanes.

[Final Chorus]
TWO PLANS — TWO PLANS
PRO ANNUAL AND THE API
TWO PLANS — TWO PLANS
ONE FOR THE BUILD ONE FOR THE WHY
TWO PLANS — TWO PLANS
BOTH OF THEM ON THE INVOICE LIST
TWO PLANS — TWO PLANS
BOTH OF THEM ON THE BUILDER WRIST

[Outro]
Which plan — which plan — which plan
Which plan are you here about
Which plan — which plan — which plan
The builder runs them both no doubt
